display.title: Episode 353: The Blessing of a Tzaddik, Chapter 2 (Erev Chanukah)
display.summary_short: The week before Chanukah: what the Chanukah lights whisper to Hashem's soldiers, a class sings about the Torah and says the Shema, and the secret of the young-looking innkeeper is revealed.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week before Chanukah 5749. Uncle Yossi teaches, in the Rebbe's words, that we must listen to what the Chanukah lights tell us: Hashem who made miracles then will make miracles now, above all the coming of Moshiach. Like Yehudah HaMaccabi's call 'Whoever is for Hashem, come to me', we join Hashem's side by learning more Torah and doing more mitzvos, growing brighter each night like the menorah. After the Hakochainik march, a third-grade girls' class visits Studio 604, sings a song thanking Hashem for the Torah, chants verses of Chumash and leads the Shema. Story time concludes The Blessing of a Tzaddik: the young-looking innkeeper tells Reb Boruch that sixty years earlier he swept the Baal Shem Tov's room at night but did not move the tzaddik's shoes, and was blessed with long life. He is really ninety, and the old man is his son. The show ends with a listener's homemade Tzivos Hashem room, Shabbos candle time and Dial-a-Jewish-Story.
display.lesson: Listen to the message of the Chanukah lights: join Hashem's side with more Torah and mitzvos, and grow a little brighter every day.

segments.title: What the Chanukah Lights Whisper
segments.summary: The Rebbe's teaching that the Chanukah lights carry a message of faith, Moshiach and growing brighter every day, with Yehudah HaMaccabi's call to be on Hashem's side.

segments.title: A third-grade class sings, reads Chumash and says the Shema
segments.summary: A visiting class sings a song of thanks for the Torah, chants verses of Chumash and leads the Shema in Hebrew and English.

segments.title: Story time: where we left off
The Blessing of a Tzaddik, Chapter 2
segments.summary: The innkeeper reveals that the Baal Shem Tov blessed him with long life for not moving his shoes, so he looks younger than his own son.

segments.title: Uncle Yossi's Mailbox: a homemade Tzivos Hashem room
segments.summary: A listener and her sister made a Tzivos Hashem room with a Chumash, a siddur and a tzedakah pushka.

relations.note: 'The Blessing of a Tzaddik' (1988): ep 352 ch. 1 and ep 353 ch. 2 are chapters of the same airing of the serial.
ep 353 ch. 2 continues 'The Blessing of a Tzaddik' (1988): ep 352 ch. 1.
Same story, another telling: 'Tanya Shiur 22: Chapters 5 and 6, Torah as Food for the Soul and Zeh L'umas Zeh' (Stories, 117:24-123:03), told by Rabbi Yosef Goldstein (Uncle Yossi).

quality.notes: ASR garbles the story hero's name (Rebbe Rashab, Rabbi Akiva for Reb Boruch). Mailbox reads a child's name and street address (see hidden). Candle time is a period piece.
